comment: Golden vectors for firmware-telemetry/v2 Reading Envelope at v 2. A consumer of this version must accept every case in 'cases' and refuse every case in 'reject_cases' and 'precedence_cases' with the declared reason. Each case is judged on its own against verifier_context, with no prior message accepted from the device. Signed with a disclosed TEST-ONLY seed: never provision it. Nonces are fixed fixture values.

reasons.unsupported_version: the envelope's v is not the integer 1 or 2
reasons.liveness_nonce_missing: v is 2 and the envelope has no liveness_nonce
reasons.liveness_nonce_at_v1: v is 1 and the envelope has liveness_nonce
reasons.invalid_liveness_nonce: v is 2 and liveness_nonce is neither null nor 32 characters each one of 0-9 or a-f
reasons.unexpected_field: v is 2 and the envelope has a key outside its eleven
reasons.capability_hash_mismatch: v1's fourth step: the envelope's capability_hash is not the accepted manifest hash
reasons.signature_verification_failed: v1's fifth step: the signature does not verify

cases.name: v2_reading_with_nonce
cases.note: a reading measured while the device held a liveness nonce

cases.name: v2_reading_null_nonce
cases.note: a reading measured while the device held none; always present, null

cases.name: v2_two_readings_with_nonce
cases.note: one nonce for the envelope: the one held before the first transaction began

cases.name: v2_heartbeat_with_nonce
cases.note: a heartbeat carries the nonce held when it is signed

cases.name: v2_heartbeat_null_nonce
cases.note: a heartbeat while no nonce is held

cases.name: v2_all_zero_nonce
cases.note: the grammar admits any 32 lowercase hex digits

cases.name: v1_reading
cases.note: a v 1 envelope is still accepted, under v1's grammar, with no liveness_nonce

cases.name: v1_heartbeat
cases.note: a v 1 heartbeat is still accepted

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_missing_nonce
reject_cases.note: v 2 requires liveness_nonce, null when none is held

reject_cases.name: reject_v1_with_null_nonce
reject_cases.note: the field is forbidden at v 1 whatever its value

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_non_hex
reject_cases.note: g is not a hexadecimal digit

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_empty
reject_cases.note: the empty string is not the spelling of none held; null is

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_integer
reject_cases.note: liveness_nonce is a string or null

reject_cases.name: reject_envelope_v0
reject_cases.note: versions start at 1; the nonce is valid, so only the version refuses it

reject_cases.name: reject_envelope_v_string
reject_cases.note: v is a JSON integer; the string "2" is another type

reject_cases.name: reject_envelope_v_true
reject_cases.note: true is a JSON boolean, not the integer 1

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_extra_field
reject_cases.note: the field set is closed at v 2: eleven keys and no other

precedence_cases.name: reject_capability_hash_before_nonce
precedence_cases.note: v1's fourth step precedes the field checks of its sixth: the manifest hash refuses it before the malformed nonce is read

precedence_cases.name: reject_signature_before_nonce
precedence_cases.note: the signature step precedes the field checks; this case's signature does not verify

precedence_cases.name: reject_nonce_at_v1_before_channel
precedence_cases.note: the nonce checks precede v1's validation of channels and readings at v 1 too

precedence_cases.name: reject_nonce_before_channel
precedence_cases.note: the nonce checks precede v1's validation of channels and readings

precedence_cases.name: reject_nonce_before_extra_field
precedence_cases.note: the nonce grammar precedes the field-set check

precedence_cases.name: reject_extra_field_before_channel
precedence_cases.note: the field-set check precedes v1's validation of channels and readings
